title: Staff Accountant
description: Maintain the general ledger, process accounts payable and receivable, prepare month-end journal entries and bank reconciliations, and support the annual audit. Strong knowledge of GAAP and advanced Excel required.

title: Legal Associate (Litigation)
description: Draft pleadings, motions and contracts, conduct legal research, manage case files and represent clients in hearings. Excellent legal writing and client communication skills.

title: Farm Operations Manager
description: Manage day-to-day farm operations, crop planning, irrigation schedules and harvest logistics. Supervise field staff, track inventory of seeds and fertiliser, and ensure food safety compliance.

title: Apparel Merchandiser
description: Coordinate apparel product development from sampling to shipment. Work with designers and factories on fabric, trims and costing, manage vendor timelines and negotiate pricing with suppliers.

title: Arts Program Coordinator
description: Plan and run community arts programs, exhibitions and workshops. Coordinate artists and volunteers, write grant applications and program descriptions, and manage event budgets.

title: Automotive Service Technician
description: Diagnose and repair vehicles, perform scheduled maintenance and inspections, use diagnostic tools to troubleshoot engine and electrical faults, and follow workshop safety procedures.

title: Aircraft Maintenance Engineer
description: Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance on commercial aircraft, carry out inspections, maintain maintenance records and ensure compliance with aviation regulations and FAA/DGCA standards.

title: Relationship Manager, Retail Banking
description: Build relationships with retail banking customers, cross-sell loans, deposits and investment products, process loan applications, and ensure KYC and compliance standards are met.

title: Customer Support Team Lead
description: Lead a team of customer support agents in an inbound call center. Monitor call quality and service levels, coach agents, handle escalations and prepare daily performance reports.

title: Business Development Manager
description: Identify new business opportunities, generate leads, build partnerships and negotiate contracts. Develop strategic growth plans and manage the sales pipeline in CRM.

title: Sous Chef
description: Support the head chef in running a busy kitchen: menu development, food preparation, kitchen staff supervision, inventory and strict food safety and hygiene standards.

title: Construction Project Manager
description: Manage residential and commercial construction projects from planning to handover. Prepare cost estimates, read blueprints, coordinate subcontractors and enforce site safety standards.

title: Management Consultant
description: Advise clients on operations and strategy. Analyse business data, identify process improvement opportunities, present recommendations to senior stakeholders and support implementation.

title: Graphic Designer
description: Create visual designs for print and digital campaigns, brand identities and marketing materials using Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign. Collaborate with the marketing team on creative concepts.

title: Digital Media Specialist
description: Plan and run digital campaigns across social media and search. Create and edit video and written content, optimise SEO, and report on engagement and audience growth.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Design mechanical components and assemblies in AutoCAD and SolidWorks, support manufacturing and testing, and work with quality control on design improvements.

title: Financial Analyst
description: Build financial models, prepare budgets and forecasts, analyse variances and produce monthly financial reports for management. Advanced Excel and strong analytical skills required.

title: Personal Fitness Trainer
description: Design personalised training programs, coach clients one-on-one and in groups, advise on nutrition and wellness, and maintain CPR certification.

title: Clinical Nurse
description: Provide direct patient care, administer medication, maintain electronic health records, coordinate with physicians and follow clinical and patient-privacy protocols.

title: HR Generalist
description: Manage end-to-end recruiting and onboarding, employee relations, benefits administration and payroll coordination. Maintain HRIS records and support performance management cycles.

title: IT Systems Administrator
description: Administer servers, networks and user accounts. Manage Active Directory, Linux and VMware environments, troubleshoot hardware and software issues and provide technical support.

title: Public Relations Executive
description: Write press releases, build media relations, manage the social media presence of clients and organise press events and launches.

title: Sales Executive
description: Achieve monthly sales targets by prospecting and managing client accounts, negotiating deals, maintaining CRM records and delivering excellent customer service.

title: High School Mathematics Teacher
description: Teach mathematics to grades 9–12, plan lessons aligned with the curriculum, manage the classroom, assess student progress and provide additional tutoring support.
